subject: OneTrust bulk QA: compressed evidence delivery and manifest questions
messages:
From: Claire Huang <claire.huang@novumcloud.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@novumcloud.com
Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: OneTrust bulk QA — compressed evidence upload and checklist

Hi Sofia / Marissa,

We're kicking off the OneTrust QA window for NovumCloud next week and we'd like to coordinate bulk evidence ingestion. A few requirements from our side:

- Preferred delivery: compressed bundles (tar.gz or zip) with a CSV manifest.
- Max individual bundle size: ideally <= 2 GB (we can accept up to 5GB but need presign support).
- Manifest columns we expect: evidence_filename, caiq_question_id, control_family, sha256, created_date, redaction_flag.
- Files should be encrypted at rest; presigned S3 upload is preferred (we will provide a bucket or accept your S3 presigns).
- Please indicate any filetypes you cannot provide (we prefer PDFs, PNGs, CSVs, but accept plain text and logs).

I've attached a small example manifest (ot_manifest_template.csv) and the Novum requirements PDF with our acceptance criteria. Can you confirm whether Redwood can:

1) Produce a compressed bundle per CAIQ section or per-control?
2) Generate the manifest with SHA256 checksums for each file?
3) Support presigned S3 uploads with a 24-48 hour TTL?

If helpful, we can run a short intake call — but ideally we'd have a plan this week so the upload can start on Monday 5/31.

Thanks,
Claire Huang
Security Programs Manager 
NovumCloud

Attachments: ot_manifest_template.csv (CSV sample), novum_ot_requirements.pdf (requirements)
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Huang <claire.huang@novumcloud.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: OneTrust bulk QA — compressed evidence upload and checklist

Thanks Claire — good checklist, and the sample manifest is very helpful. High level plan from Redwood: 

- We will produce compressed bundles per CAIQ section (e.g., A.1, A.2, etc.) to make mapping explicit and keep bundle sizes small. Default target: ~1.5 GB per bundle.
- We will generate a manifest with the exact columns you listed (we'll include sha256 and a Redwood internal id).
- We can provide presigned S3 uploads. Ben (cc'd) will confirm TTL and KMS settings.

Action items for our side:
- Ben: confirm presign TTL and whether we can create consumer-presigned links to a Novum bucket or if we should provide our own.
- Marissa: coordinate QA contact and confirm any evidence redaction rules Novum requires.
- Sofia: produce Redwood_bulk_evidence_mapping_v1.csv (initial mapping of CAIQ IDs -> likely evidence files) and share a sample compressed bundle.

Can you confirm the following so we can finalize the upload schedule?
- Do you require bundles to be named with the CAIQ section prefix, e.g. novum_A1_20270531.tar.gz?
- Is 48h presign TTL acceptable if the file sizes are >2GB?
- Any special retention/expiration rules on your side (we can also hold copies for 30 days if needed).

Planning note: we'll prepare a dry-run sample bundle by Wednesday (5/26) and once you sign off we'll schedule the full upload for 5/31.

Best,
Sofia Ivanova
Senior Trust & Safety Program Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood_bulk_evidence_mapping_v1.csv (mapping draft)
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Huang <claire.huang@novumcloud.com>, Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: OneTrust bulk QA — compressed evidence upload and checklist

On Mon, May 24, 2027 at 9:12 AM Claire Huang <claire.huang@novumcloud.com> wrote:
> - Preferred delivery: compressed bundles (tar.gz or zip) with a CSV manifest.
> - Max individual bundle size: ideally <= 2 GB (we can accept up to 5GB but need presign support).

Quick technical clarifications from infra:
- Presign TTL: we can support configurable presign TTLs up to 7 days. Default we'll provide 48h for large objects.
- KMS/encryption: uploads to Redwood-managed bucket will be server-side encrypted (SSE-KMS). If you want to presign to your bucket, we can generate presigns for PUT; your bucket policy will apply.
- Checksum: we'll compute sha256 client-side and include it in the manifest and as an object metadata header (x-amz-meta-sha256).
- Filetypes: logs over 200MB we'll gzip internally; otherwise we will keep original if you prefer.
- Upload automation: we can hand over a small CLI script for your ingestion or provide a one-time presigned form.

Suggested manifest columns (final): evidence_filename, caiq_id, control_family, redwood_id, sha256, filesize_bytes, created_date, presign_url, presign_ttl_seconds, redaction_flag

I'll stand up a presign endpoint tomorrow and share sample URLs with the dry-run.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Claire Huang <claire.huang@novumcloud.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, security@novumcloud.com
Date: Wed, 26 May 2027 16:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: OneTrust bulk QA — compressed evidence upload and checklist

Perfect — this all looks good.

Confirming:
- We accept bundles per CAIQ section, named with the pattern novum_<section>_<yyyymmdd>.tar.gz.
- 48h presign TTL is acceptable for files >2GB.
- NovumCloud will provide a bucket policy; if Redwood generates presigns to a Redwood bucket, Novum confirms that is acceptable for this intake.

Next steps:
1) Please upload a dry-run sample bundle by EOD Thursday 5/27 to the Drive link below and include your sample manifest. We'll validate a handful of items and send any quick feedback.
2) If dry-run looks good we'll schedule the bulk upload on Monday 5/31.
3) Point of contact for ingestion issues: Claire (security@novumcloud.com) — ping me directly and we'll triage.

Drive folder (for dry-run): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cOtBulkQA-sample

Thanks for the quick turnaround. If anything changes I'll flag it here.

Claire Huang
Security Programs Manager
NovumCloud

Attachments: novum_ot_requirements.pdf
